scope: Profiles and Python-visible copy/scan counters are separate diagnostic observations. Full CLI profile includes normal startup, conversion, validation, source/provenance hashes, processing and output. Separate import probe reports import costs only; warm recipe APIs retain validation/provenance.
public_scope: Separate diagnostic runs, excluded from all126timing observations. cProfile covers Runtime.measure including post-API signature/report work; use the Runtime.operation/run_operations subtree for engine interpretation. Instrumentation gates only the timed API. Native C++ internal allocations are not directly counted.
